coolhunting.title: The Office
coolhunting.notes: Adds two Dispatch pieces (Bevel, Waugh Thistleton's first US project in Bellevue — a mass-timber office tower approved for 100% exposed ceilings under a code path previously tested only on housing; and Ciel Dubai Marina, the newly opened world's-tallest hotel, read as the counter-argument to this issue's retrofit thread). No dispatch retired — the oldest (Stirling shortlist, 16 July) is at roughly five and a half weeks and should retire next cycle. Adds three organiser-confirmed calendar dates: the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art opening (22 September), the Sharjah Architecture Triennial's third edition (14 November 2026 – 14 April 2027), and the Guggenheim Abu Dhabi opening (11 December).
